readme.section: DSH 动森主题 · Animal Island UI
readme.text:
`Animal Island UI` 是 DeepSeek Harness（Web 与 Windows 桌面端）的主题插件，视觉参考自开源组件库 [animal-island-ui](https://github.com/guokaigdg/animal-island-ui)。

编码工作台需要长时间盯屏读代码、看 diff，直接照搬高饱和度的游戏配色很容易视觉疲劳。因此这套主题把重心放在了「纸面」与「边界」上：对话区与代码区采用低对比的奶油手账纸和暖棕木色，让阅读面安静下来；而在侧栏船票、标题木牌、输入框气泡这些外围界面上，保留一点手账与海岛的小巧思。所有改动都停留在样式与公开插槽层，不改动 DSH 原有的布局、快捷键和交互习惯。

> [!NOTE]
> 本项目为开源社区插件，与 DeepSeek 官方及 Nintendo（任天堂）无任何隶属、授权或背书关系。主题仅消费 DSH 公开的 ThemeRuntime Token 与 Slot 接缝，不包含任何受版权保护的游戏专有资产；DSH 升级后若接缝变更可自动回退到原生界面。

---

<details>
<summary>展开查看：日间 / 夜间工作台与侧栏实拍（基于真实 DSH DOM 夹具渲染）</summary>

| 日间模式 (Light) | 夜间模式 (Dark) |
| --- | --- |
|  |  |
|  |  |

</details>

---

- **昼夜两套画布**
  - **日间**：双层波点草坪、底部波浪与低透明度漂浮叶片，主内容区铺设半透明奶油白纸面。
  - **夜间**：独立调校的深色方案。深青色夜空与星点画布，配冷色侧栏与暖棕内容纸面，代码块采用深棕底色。
- **手账部件与交互细节**
  - **渡岛船票品牌区**：将侧栏顶部 `24px` 的新会话入口扩展为 `216×60` 的船票样式（奶油纸面、薄荷票根与打孔撕口）。
  - **木牌与对话气泡**：顶部路径采用木质绶带，侧栏选中项改为竖向木纹牌，底部输入框加了对话气泡尾标与纸纹。
  - **焦点与按压反馈**：主按钮带实体底边与按压位移；键盘焦点环改为 `2px` 内嵌薄荷环，避免在 DSH 的滚动容器边缘被裁切。
- **应用内外观设置**
  - 在「**设置 → 插件 → 动森外观**」中提供「纸白 / 均衡 / 海岛」三档预设与 `0.15–0.60` 画布浓度滑杆，带实时分层预览。
  - 可单独开关**插画装饰**、**纸纹颗粒**、**浅色 Diff 语法配色**（暖色 / DSH 原生）与**界面字体**（Nunito 拉丁字体 / 系统默认字体）。偏好保存在当前客户端的 `localStorage` 中。
- **实现边界**
  - 覆盖 118 项 `ThemeRuntime` Token 与 4 个公开 Slot，不使用 DOM 轮询、`MutationObserver` 或构建期随机哈希类名。
  - 字体（Nunito WOFF2）与原创 SVG 插画在构建期直接内嵌进 bundle，运行时不发起外部网络请求。
建议同一 profile 下只启用一个主题插件。
在 DSH 内打开「**设置 → 插件**」，搜索 **`Animal Island UI`** 或 **`动森`** 安装，重启应用生效。

readme.section: 方式二：通过 NPM 安装到 Profile
readme.text:
进入你的 DSH profile 目录直接安装：

```sh
cd <DSH_Profile_目录>
pnpm add dsh-theme-animal-island-ui
```

安装后**完整重启 DSH 服务并刷新页面**。

readme.section: 方式三：离线 `.tgz` 安装包
readme.text:
从 [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/Shirolin/dsh-theme-animal-island-ui/releases) 下载对应版本的 `.tgz` 与 `SHA256SUMS`：

```sh
cd <DSH_Profile_目录>
pnpm add file:<下载目录>/dsh-theme-animal-island-ui-<version>.tgz
```

DSH 桌面客户端使用独立的 `desktop` profile，并依赖客户端内置的 Electron Node 运行时执行安装。详细步骤、热更新与回滚方式见 [桌面客户端指南 (docs/desktop.md)](docs/desktop.md)。

如果已克隆本仓库，可用脚本一键打包并同步到本机的 `web` 与 `desktop` 两个 profile：

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm run install:local
```

---

环境要求：**Node.js ≥ 22.13**，**pnpm 11.1.2**。

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm run build          # 构建客户端 bundle 与类型声明（输出至 lib/）
pnpm run check          # 完整门禁：站点检查 + 类型 + 构建 + 单元/契约测试 + DSH 兼容性核对
pnpm run format         # Biome 格式化

**离屏夹具与视觉验证**（抽取本机 DSH 真实 CSS 渲染 DOM 并执行浏览器内断言，截图输出至 `artifacts/smoke/`）：

```sh
pnpm run fixture sidebar-masthead            # 渲染指定夹具（自动探测本机 Web 或桌面端 DSH 运行时）
pnpm run fixture boot-loading --desktop      # 显式使用桌面端 app.asar 运行时渲染
pnpm run check:visual                        # 运行侧栏船票的 DOM 几何与样式门禁
```

**子路径导出**（供外部脚本或工具直接复用色板与对比度计算）：

```ts
import { ANIMAL_ISLAND_PALETTES } from 'dsh-theme-animal-island-ui/palette'
import { buildTokenOverrides, contrastRatio } from 'dsh-theme-animal-island-ui/tokens'
```

- [侧栏会话列表空白排查 (docs/session-list-blank.md)](docs/session-list-blank.md)：一次 DSH 侧持久化快照引发槽位崩溃的诊断记录

readme.section: DSH Animal Island Theme · Animal Island UI
readme.text: `Animal Island UI` is a theme plugin for DeepSeek Harness (Web and Windows Desktop), visually inspired by the open-source component library [animal-island-ui](https://github.com/guokaigdg/animal-island-ui).

readme.section: DSH Animal Island Theme · Animal Island UI
readme.text: Because a coding workspace is meant for hours of reading diffs and logs, directly copying high-saturation game colors quickly causes eye strain. This theme focuses on calm reading surfaces and strict layout boundaries: conversations and code sit on low-contrast cream paper and warm wood tones, while peripheral chrome—the sidebar boarding pass, wooden header ribbon, and speech-bubble composer—carries the tactile notebook character. All changes stay within CSS tokens and public slots, leaving DSH's native layouts, shortcuts, and interactions untouched.

readme.section: DSH Animal Island Theme · Animal Island UI
readme.text:
> [!NOTE]
> This is an independent open-source community plugin with no affiliation, endorsement, or sponsorship from DeepSeek or Nintendo. It builds solely on DSH's public ThemeRuntime tokens and slots without proprietary game assets, and degrades safely to default DSH styles across upstream upgrades.

---

- **Day & Night Canvases**
  - **Light**: Dual-grid polka-dot lawn, bottom wave border, and low-opacity floating leaves behind a translucent cream reading sheet.
  - **Dark**: A dedicated night palette pairing a deep teal starry canvas and cool slate sidebar with warm brown reading surfaces and dark timber code blocks.
- **Notebook Chrome & Tactile Details**
  - **Boarding-Pass Masthead**: Expands DSH's `24px` new-session button into a `216×60` ferry ticket with cream paper, a mint counterfoil, and a perforated tear seam.
  - **Wooden Signs & Speech Bubble**: Wooden header ribbons, vertical wood-grain active rows in the sidebar, and a speech-bubble composer with subtle paper grain.
  - **Focus & Press Feedback**: Tactile bottom borders on primary buttons and a `2px` inset mint focus ring that stays visible inside clipped scroll containers.
- **In-App Appearance Settings**
  - Available under **Settings → Plugins → Animal Island Appearance**, offering three presets (*Paper*, *Balanced*, *Island*) and a `0.15–0.60` canvas veil slider with live layered preview.

Keep only one theme plugin enabled per profile.
Open **Settings → Plugins** in DSH, search for **`Animal Island UI`**, install, and restart the app.

readme.section: Option 2: Install via NPM into a Profile
readme.text:
Run inside your target DSH profile directory:

```sh
cd <dsh-profile-directory>
pnpm add dsh-theme-animal-island-ui
```

Restart the DSH service completely and refresh the browser.

Download the `.tgz` tarball and `SHA256SUMS` from [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/Shirolin/dsh-theme-animal-island-ui/releases):

```sh
cd <dsh-profile-directory>
pnpm add file:<download-directory>/dsh-theme-animal-island-ui-<version>.tgz
```

DSH Desktop uses an isolated `desktop` profile managed by its bundled Electron Node runtime. See [Desktop Client Guide (docs/desktop.md)](docs/desktop.md) for installation, HMR updates, and rollback steps.

From a local clone of this repository, you can pack and sync into both `web` and `desktop` profiles in one step:

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm run install:local
```

---

Requires **Node.js ≥ 22.13** and **pnpm 11.1.2**.

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm run build          # Build client bundle and type declarations into lib/
pnpm run check          # Full gate: site check + typecheck + build + tests + DSH compat check
pnpm run format         # Format with Biome

**Offscreen DOM Fixtures** (renders real DSH CSS in Headless Chrome, runs in-browser assertions, and writes screenshots to `artifacts/smoke/`):

```sh
pnpm run fixture sidebar-masthead            # Render fixture (auto-detects local Web or Desktop DSH runtime)
pnpm run fixture boot-loading --desktop      # Explicitly extract and use desktop app.asar runtime
pnpm run check:visual                        # Run the sidebar ticket geometry & style gate
```

**Subpath Exports** (for external tools reusing the palette or contrast utilities):

```ts
import { ANIMAL_ISLAND_PALETTES } from 'dsh-theme-animal-island-ui/palette'
import { buildTokenOverrides, contrastRatio } from 'dsh-theme-animal-island-ui/tokens'
```
